Author: Will Corrigan
Name: Wayfarer
Punchline: A quest arrow that knows the way: teleports, doors and aethernet included — plus an unlock checklist.
Description: Guides you to your quest objective with an on-screen arrow that understands teleports, building entrances and city aethernet routing. Tracks every quest-unlockable feature, mount and dungeon you can pick up right now, and routes you to the quest givers.
